lines.en: It all used to look like this.
Long ago, when the sun still shone — when the sweat on your skin made it stick to the sleeves of that old blazer as you wandered mindlessly through the better part of this world.
I assume you barely remember that now. And on the off chance you do, I imagine it’s because you forced yourself to.
Either something spoke to you or you spoke to something. So either this worm has always been a part of you or you went back to find it.
Are you happy now — peering into the mason jar you used to recreate its habitat? Carefully combing through all of the information you can find in an effort to know a little more than you did before?

A worm is just a worm, you know. And while I’m glad you’d take it upon yourself to go so far out of your way to properly care for it, I’d be foolish to not advise you that there’s always a chance this could lead to regret.

Because right now, there are thousands of other people on the Internet talking about worms — spewing their thoughts and feelings out into the ether. What one person says is right, another says is wrong.
But it’s not like the worm can ever tell you which leaves it prefers, so there’s no way of knowing if you chose the right ones.
If you don’t like worms, maybe you like fleas. Maybe you found a handful of those. Maybe you’re starting a circus.
So you send your cats out to wander the fields, using a comb to weed them all out several days later.
But the thing with fleas is that you’ll never be able to comb all of them out. You can go through that fur until your cat is bald and you’ll still find their dirt on its skin.

What this means is that time is limited for everyone. Even the ones you may have believed could live on forever. The truth is they won’t. The truth is they’ll be forgotten. All of this will be forgotten.
But that doesn’t change the pursuit of knowledge. It doesn’t change that curiosity alone is the driving force behind the success of man. But cats are not the only thing curiosity can kill.
So the goal then becomes to dig up some sort of happy medium. To find two people who know about worms and are willing to reach an agreement. Or to start up a flea sideshow instead of a circus.
There are so many things you can do. There are so many worlds you can build. Yet you long for the days of zmr_005_LUT32 with that heavy-left slider because that is when things felt simple.
That is when you could wander through the better part of town, asking yourself questions like “Why’s that one the way it is?” or “I wonder what will happen when that thing happens?”
Simple questions. Easy questions. Questions that seem like nothing now that there’s a divine compendium and countless threads running simultaneously while a single red one still hangs overhead.
It’s so high up you don’t know when you’ll reach it. I don’t know when you’ll reach it. And every day, it gets further and further away.
This is not the world that you knew. Just like those long hallways that faintly smelled of chlorine and scraggly green carpets also seem impossible now. It’s because they are.
Everything changes whether you want it to or not. Sometimes it’s for the better. Sometimes it’s not. But it’s hard to ever really know that until you make it to the next world.
I wonder what color the next carpet will be?
I wonder if I’ll like it.
I don’t know if I’ll like it.
I just know that if I don’t make it there, the next click will be me.
Trash is collected every Tuesday and Friday.
The other five days, I am waiting.
It’s not a hint. It’s motivation.
For those days when everything tastes grey.
One day, I hope someone will get it.
Until then, I’ll have a soliloquy to keep me company.
It has no mouth. It can not see.
But God does it hold me tightly.
: So I guess we’re just headed back to the hotel now?...
: We can come back to school tomorrow night if you feel like reading again. It’s trickier getting into the basement during school hours.

: I’m confused as to how you can keep so much stuff down there in the first place. Has anyone ever, like...tried moving any of it? I’m sure the sports clubs have to go into the basement from time to time, don’t they?
: You should be confused. It’s a confusing subject. And if you want my honest answer, I’d say it’s because the rules of this world and logic as a whole don’t really apply to me.
: Which means that, by extension, they probably don’t apply to you either now or I’m just flat out wrong.  Probably the former if I had to guess.
: I’d guess the latter. You were wrong pretty frequently in my world. And you were wrong about that thing with the emergency escape instructions earlier too.
: A watched clock is right twice a day, Ayane.
: I’m pretty sure you used that phrase incorrectly as well.
: That phrase is incorrect on a conceptual basis when time is quite literally just a thing we made up. How can a clock be right when there’s no correct answer?
: Can we not get all philosophical right now? I’ve had a long, miserable day and I need to turn my mind off for a few minutes so I can get a tiny reprieve before my nightly panic attack.
: Would you rather just sleep at the dorms instead? I can’t imagine being in an environment as loud as that hotel will do you any favors if you’re trying to take your mind off of things.
: Will you come with me if I say yes?
: Sure.
: You’re the closest thing I have to a friend in this world. Even if the me who befriended you is no longer present.
: The fact remains that you’re the only person who understands me. And that’s surely good for something, isn’t it?
: Y...Yeah. You just...never really put it that way when you were alive.
: F...Forgive me for wording it that way, though. It’s not like you technically died. It’s just easier to say that than “you were suspiciously replaced with a clone” every time.
: Just because I didn’t say it doesn’t mean I never thought it. And even if I doubted you, which I most assuredly did, I likely enjoyed your company on at least some level.
: Maybe we can sleep in the same bed then?!
: Denied.
: And we can hold each other and cry about how we’re the only two people in this universe who know about how cruel and unfair and evil it is!
: Denied again. Did you not hear me the first time?
: Yay! We’re going to have so much fun together! I’m gonna love you so hard that you won’t even know what hit you!
: You’re disgusting. I take back all of the compassionate things I said. Please leave me alone for the rest of your time on this planet.
: I’m only teasing you, obviously. I know you like your space. At least with everyone not named Ami. You’ve never once put up a fight when she asks to share a bed.
: Me, though? Pfft. Somebody’s sleeping on the floor.
: Is that a thing we did often where you come from?
: Wait, is it not a thing you do often here? Are you and Ami not particularly close in this timeline?
: Not in this one, no. She’s barely shown an interest in me with Sensei taking up her every waking moment.
: The loop before this one was the opposite, though. We were...certainly close there.
: Yeah, it’s super weird to hear that you’re not here. I kind of just always associate the two of you together.
: I guess you started “falling out of love” in the last world, though. Right before the whole character swap thing happened.
: What do you mean by that?
: It wasn’t anything personal, I don’t think. Ami got weird with everybody. And it only got worse after you died.
: Like, she’s always been a little crazy. But at one point, it seemed like she was almost trying to, like, get Sensei to hate us or something.
: You didn’t tell her about the loops, did you?
: Of course not. You always said not to and then got all intense about how she’d kill me and everyone else or something.
: Hmm...
: Yeah, I’m not really sure then-
: Aaaah! Finally!
: Yumi? What’s-

: I’ve been lookin’ all over the fuckin’ place for you, Blondie! Tried like three different phones and none of ‘em worked! Did the thing happen?! It did, right?! Is it always this fuckin’ disorienting?!
: The...thing?
: No fucking way...
: The friggin’ apocalypse or whatever! One minute we were at your place and the next-
: You...You came too?! You were at the party?! Are we thinking of the right one?! What was I dressed as?!
: I don’t know...A fuckin’...BDSM girl? With a...tail thing?
: Holy shit, you were there!

: I have...several questions about your choice of a costume, but I am going to ignore them in favor of asking if this is a usual occurrence for you. You did mention Yumi being a part of this, correct?
: Yeah, but she’s never made it through one before! If I had known that was possible, I would have looked for her too!
: So this shit ain’t normal then? Cause I didn’t think we’d go all the way back here.
: You weren’t by any chance impregnated by the teacher, were you?
: Maya, don’t start. Seriously.
: Impregnated?! Are you out of your fuckin’ mind?!
: Just figured I’d ask. Might as well follow in my own footsteps if it gets me back to Sensei one day.
: Love is a working theory of mine, though. So if Yumi’s feelings are strong enough for Sensei, perhaps it’s possible that she’d have hitched a ride with-
: Oh...wait.
: I guess that theory falls apart if Sensei himself wasn’t sent here.
: Just what the hell decides this? I don’t get it.
: Love?...No way, I...
: I mean, we did kiss once though?...So if you’re lookin’ for theories-
: Since when?! When the fuck did that happen?!
: You’re supposed to be one of the safe, non-threatening ones! If you’re already kissing Sensei, everyone is going to be kissing Sensei soon! I don’t want to see that!
: Could be worse. I’ve had multiple threesomes with every single girl in the class.
: You’ve what?!
: I didn’t need to know that, Maya!
: What? I told you I’d be honest now that you’ve earned my trust. The more you know about me, the better you’ll be able to take advantage of me when you go home.
: It’s a calculated move, Ayane. Now’s not the time to question it.
: But still! Yumi’s a virgin in our timeline! She doesn’t need to be hearing about weird threesomes in alternate realities!
: How are you sure she’s a virgin? She could be fucking him behind your back.
: Man, seriously? I just dealt with this shit the other day and now I gotta do it again with someone who barely even knows me? Shit’s weak, dude.
: No, Maya. I know for a fact because I-
: Because...
: Wait...because I...
: Why...Why do I know that again?...
: Something’s...something’s not coming to me, I...I think I’m-
: Forget it, Blondie. We’ve got bigger fish to fry right now. I bumped into my cousin a couple hours ago and she said another one of those fuckin’ reset things’ is gonna happen tonight.
: Tonight?! Are you sure?! And who the hell is your cousin?! Why do they know about this?!

: Kaori Kadowaki. You’ve probably seen her at...every fuckin’ restaurant in Kumon-mi. And it beats the fuck outta me how she knows about this shit. But I clearly ain’t in the position to be callin’ people out on that.
: Kaori knows about the resets?...
: It can’t be tonight...no. No, I haven’t felt anything at all. I’d know if it was coming.
: Yeah, unless you’re wrong again! This might be the only chance we have to get out of here, Maya!
: So I’m going to follow Kaori’s advice for now and question just how she’s involved later! We’ve gotta get to the roof!
: Yeah, I...
: What’s wrong?! Is this really the time to hesitate?! It could happen at any moment if what Kaori said is true!
: Hah...
: Maya...come on.
: I will. I just...
: I need to do something first.
: ...What?
: You two head to the school now. I’ll meet you there once I’m done. I promise.
: I don’t like this, Maya. You’re keeping something from me again. You always do that and it never helps at all. And I don’t want you missing your chance to come home over something so-
: I won’t be long. I promise.
: So please allow me to be dishonest one last time.
: So, like...we’re supposed to go to the roof of the school? Cause I’ll book it there right now. I ain’t gotta wait around for whatever lesbian shit’s goin’ on here.
: No, Yumi. I’ll come with you. But Maya-
: If you’re about to hit me with some sappy goodbye, don’t. I’ll be there.
: And we’ll surely meet again.
: So, uhh...
: Is it just me, or does “we’ll surely meet again” sound super fuckin’ final to you?
: It does...and I hate that she said that.
: But Maya’s going to be Maya. And if she’s going to make me do something as stupid as choosing between her or everyone else I love, of course I’m not going to wait around.
: This might be my only chance to get back to Sensei...and Ami...and Sana...and this might be your only chance to get back to Chika. And...whoever else you care about.
: I don’t know...I kinda like the Chika in this world better. And that’s even factorin’ in how the one here is dressed like a literal bitch in heat.
: You don’t mean that, Yumi. Friendship isn’t that flimsy.
: I promise, though. The apocalypse is only scary at first. You’ll get used to it pretty quickly if you’re going to be joining us from now on.
: No, it ain’t that...
: Like...yeah, that shit sounds lowkey terrifying. But Chika’s gotten fuckin’ weird lately. Like somethin’ fuckin’ snapped and turned her into a different girl outta nowhere.
: Maybe that’s just growing up? Sana’s been weird lately too. So has Makoto. And Ami’s been changing personas so frequently lately that I never know which one I’m going to get when I visit her.
: Maybe this is just how things are meant to be, though?

: Maybe some of us are supposed to feel left behind while everyone else keeps moving forward? I wouldn’t put it past this world to fuck some of us over that way when we’re already being put through this.
: So, we’re...tryin’ to go back then?
: Is that not what you want?
: I don’t know...
: I feel like that’s what I should do, but...I’ve got just as much in this world as I did in the other one. And with some extra time, maybe I’d...
: Maybe I could do shit a little better? Be nicer to some people...go to that convenience store a little earlier...actually call my mom...
: That shit seems harder where we come from. Doin’ everything seems harder where we come from. And somethin’ about this place just feels less...I don’t know...real?
: Maybe I just ain’t settled in yet?...
: Maybe shit’ll get just as hard as it is back home.
: Did you feel this way after your first reset too? Or am I just bein’ a sappy piece of shit?
: You never have to worry about being sappy around me, Yumi. I get it.
: This is nothing like my first time, though. And I want to get out of here as soon as possible.
: Yeah, but you’re only sayin’ that cause you’ve got a “future husband” in that other world. I ain’t got that to look forward to back there.
: Do you want to look forward to that, though?
: Because if you do...or if you even think you might...home is where you’re going to find it.
: There’s nothing for us here.
: We’re just wearing someone else’s clothes.
